headerDisplay: Unofficial plugin: not affiliated with or endorsed by EcoWater. Reads your softener from the HydroLink Home cloud using an undocumented API, and is read-only. Provided as-is.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to read the softener. The flow alarm needs 30 continuous minutes to trip, so 300 is plenty.

saltTankMaxTenths.title: Salt tank full value
saltTankMaxTenths.description: Value of salt_level_tenths when the tank is full. Adjust until the percentage matches the HydroLink app.

alarmConfirmPolls.title: Polls an alarm must stay on before it trips
alarmConfirmPolls.description: Raise to 2 or 3 to ignore one-off readings.

exposeWaterUsage.title: Show "Water Used Today" sensor
exposeWaterUsage.description: Gallons used today, shown in Apple Home as a light sensor (HomeKit has no volume sensor, so the unit reads "lux" but the number is gallons).

exposeTestSwitch.title: Show "Test Flow Alarm" switch
exposeTestSwitch.description: A HomeKit switch that forces the Continuous Flow Alarm on for a short time so you can test your automations. It switches itself off.

staleAfterMinutes.title: Report "Softener Offline" after (minutes without good data)
staleAfterMinutes.description: While offline, flow alarms cannot be reported. Attach an automation to the Softener Offline sensor.

statusPagePort.title: Status page port
statusPagePort.description: Serves a read-only status page at http://<this-host>:<port>/ . Set 0 to turn it off. It shows water and salt data to anyone who can reach this port, so don't expose it to the internet.

statusPageBind.title: Status page listen address
statusPageBind.description: 0.0.0.0 = reachable from your network. Use 127.0.0.1 to allow only this machine.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL (optional)
webhookUrl.description: Receives a JSON POST whenever an alarm trips or clears.
